title: sync_capture_block records capture_blocked as applied even when apply_native_sharing did nothing (no window handle / no NSWindow), so a failed block is never retried
trigger: macOS or Windows: the first render of the main or a chat window cannot get its native handle while a secret chat is open
effect: frame.capture_blocked (and ChatWindowView::capture_blocked) says blocked, the window is capturable, and nothing re-applies until the wanted value changes; a secret chat can be screenshotted
fix: apply_sharing returns whether it applied; record the flag only on true (Applied/Wanted/Failed stage)

title: Editing the draft while Applying writes Editing over the in-flight stage and drops its waiting request ids; closing the box does the same
trigger: Press Apply, then change a swatch (or press Close) before the answers arrive; the first plan fails
effect: the failure is never shown (the ids no longer match), Apply is enabled again and a second plan can race the first on the server; only the 'update requested' note was shown
fix: Disable edits and Apply while Applying (edit_chat_appearance refuses), or keep the in-flight ids in the box until each answers and show a late failure as a note

title: The boost level has no Failed stage: a failed getChatBoostStatus leaves the entry absent, so the box says 'Checking this channel's boost level...' forever
trigger: Open Appearance while getChatBoostStatus fails (offline, error)
effect: the level line never settles and Apply answers LevelUnknown with 'Checking the boost level...' each press; nothing tells the user the check failed
fix: Fetch<(level, boosts)> per chat (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) and a Retry row; Apply on Failed re-asks

title: bar_unarchive dismisses the action bar even when the unarchive or notification reset failed
trigger: press Unarchive in the contact bar while the send fails
effect: the bar is dismissed and only an error note remains; the person cannot retry from the bar
fix: dismiss only after both requests were accepted

title: non-test Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> borrow_mut().take() in a dialog content closure
trigger: the dialog content closure runs a second time for the same build
effect: second run takes None and draws an empty body
fix: build the body inside the closure (or a shared scrollable_dialog_content_once helper) instead of a take-once slot

title: baseline: HeaderFacts::is_saved_messages
trigger: a fact about the open chat read once per menu build
effect: none
fix: derive from the chat kind inside header_entries

title: ChatListKeys holds two sources of one selection as four Options (list, list_mouse, search, search_mouse)
trigger: keys write list/search, hover writes list_mouse/search_mouse, mouse move clears list/search by hand, Enter reads keys.or(mouse)
effect: none today
fix: Selection { None, Keys(row), Pointer(row) } per list

title: list_mouse is cleared only by an on_hover(false) of its own row
trigger: hover a chat row, scroll the virtual list so the row unmounts without a hover-out, press Enter
effect: Enter opens the row that scrolled away instead of the first row
fix: drop list_mouse when its row leaves the laid-out items, or derive it from the pointer position each frame

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut in render (begin_search_rows, push_search_row)
trigger: search results render while a borrow of search_order or search_bounds is live (step_search_selection, reveal_search_row hold borrow() across calls)
effect: a re-entrant borrow panics
fix: try_borrow_mut with early return like the bounds recorders, or Cell/own Vec rebuilt per frame

title: Pinned-row drag is PinStage::Dragging(PinDrag{reorder}) and PinReorder.stage Dragging/Dropped: held vs sliding is a second stage nested under the first (src/pin_reorder.rs:77)
trigger: Release a dragged pinned chat: pin.reorder.release() flips the inner stage to Dropped while PinStage stays Dragging until settle() runs; callers check reorder.dragging().is_none() to tell the two
effect: No bug found; the same fact is two values and callers must consult both
fix: PinStage::{Idle, Pressed, Dragging(PinDrag), Sliding(PinDrag)} with the inner stage removed

title: my_chats_open: Option<bool> is a three-state enum (closed, groups, channels) as Option<bool>
trigger: main_menu_extras sets Some(channels) and clears it in four places; reader unwraps with unwrap_or(false)
effect: none today
fix: enum MyChats { Closed, Groups, Channels }

title: Box open flags beside the dialog stack: downloads_panel_open, archive_hint_open, pending_close_secret_chat
trigger: each is set and cleared by hand at its own sites (archive_hint.rs has four clears); the dialog registry reads them through a predicate
effect: none today; a clear missed on a new exit leaves the box coming back
fix: fold each into the DialogKind registry value that owns the box (Option<Box> or enum carrying data)

title: pending_story_open is a waiting stage whose failure is read from another struct's retry clock
trigger: tap a story that is not cached; resolve_pending_story_open decides Failed from stories.story_fetch.retry(..).is_some() on each render
effect: none today; if the retry clock is cleared elsewhere the open waits forever on Loading
fix: PendingStoryOpen { Waiting{request}, ..} matched by RequestId, resolved from the fetch answer

title: menu and archive_menu are two independent Option menus that can both be set
trigger: right-click a chat row, then right-click the Archived row
effect: two context menus may both be shown
fix: one ChatListMenu { None, Row(ChatMenuState), Archive(Point) }

title: dimming is mirrored from dimming_slider by a subscription and the two must stay equal
trigger: the slider emits Change/Release and a detached subscription writes dialog.dimming
effect: none today; Apply reads dimming, the slider shows its own value
fix: read the slider value on Apply, or keep only dimming and set the slider from it

title: Wallpaper file picker answer is matched by chat id, in a detached task
trigger: open the look dialog for chat A, press From file, close the dialog and reopen it for A before the picker answers
effect: the file lands in the new dialog of the same chat
fix: hold the picker task in the dialog (or a pick stage with an id) so closing drops it

title: LookStage::Blocked keeps its reason after the choices change
trigger: Apply on a boosted chat that is below the level, then pick another wallpaper or theme
effect: the old 'level required' error stays under the grid until the next Apply
fix: every edit of theme/wallpaper/dimming returns stage to Editing

title: non-test Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> borrow_mut().take() in a dialog content closure
trigger: the dialog content closure runs a second time for the same build
effect: second run takes None and draws an empty body
fix: build the body inside the closure (or a shared scrollable_dialog_content_once helper) instead of a take-once slot

title: The auto-delete picker has no single closer: its reset is written at three places
trigger: Close the TTL dialog via on_close, the spec close, or leaving the chat
effect: notify.ttl_picker = None is repeated (chat_setting_dialogs.rs 70 and 113, chat_ui_state.rs 592) while mute and folder menus have close_* fns
fix: one close_ttl_picker fn used by all three

title: baseline: ChatSwipeFacts::is_saved
trigger: Swipe on Saved Messages
effect: A fact about the chat (cannot be muted), not a stage; no bug today
fix: allow-list with reason (it is a fact of the chat) or SwipeFacts chat kind enum

title: enter_chat_ui drops a Sending edit without forgetting its request ack
trigger: Edit a message in chat A, press Save (edit goes out, stage Sending), then pick chat B before TDLib answers
effect: An awaited then settled entry stays in Session::acks for the rest of the session; docs say leaving the chat forgets the request
fix: enter_chat_ui takes old.edit_mode before replace_chat_ui reads old.edit_sending(); forget the request of the dropped edit (call leave-edit path / forget before take)

title: Esc and confirm while an edit is Sending cancels locally but the edit still lands
trigger: Save an edit, press Esc before the answer, confirm Cancel editing
effect: Edit cancelled note and the draft restored, yet the message is edited on the server; the answer is forgotten
fix: set_cancel_edit_confirm / request_cancel_edit should be a variant of EditStage (Editing, ConfirmingCancel, Sending) so Sending refuses cancel

title: EditMode::confirm_cancel bool sits beside EditStage
trigger: Open the cancel box, then Sending can begin or end while the flag stays set
effect: Two fields of one edit changed by hand (stage, confirm_cancel, replace_as_file)
fix: EditStage { Editing, ConfirmingCancel, Sending(RequestId) }

title: Scheduled-messages box is scheduled_dialog_open plus scheduled_selected kept in step by hand
trigger: Tick scheduled messages, Esc the dialog (on_close clears only the open flag), selection survives until a button or key reopen clears it; Reschedule selected relies on it surviving the hide
effect: Stale selection can be read by RescheduleSelected path if a reopen route forgets the clear (open_scheduled_dialog itself does not clear)
fix: enum ScheduledBox { Closed, Open{selected}, Rescheduling{selected} } in ChatUi

title: QuotePicker { Closed, Open } is a bool in disguise inside ReplyBar
trigger: Update Quote opens it; reply replaced or sent closes it
effect: Two-variant open flag beside the reply
fix: ReplyBar stage { Plain, PickingQuote } or fold into the reply value

title: Index bar pointer is two Options (index_cursor hover, index_current scrub) cleared separately
trigger: Hover and hold on the contacts index bar, then release, change sort, or type in the search field
effect: No visible bug today: mouse-up clears only index_current, sort toggle clears only index_cursor, search change clears only index_current, hover-exit clears both
fix: enum IndexBar { Away, Over(cursor), Scrubbing { cursor, slot } } with one reset

title: Schedule shortcut sets picker.send_after by hand after open_schedule_picker(Composer)
trigger: Press the Schedule shortcut with text in the composer
effect: send_after (and send_effect) is a mode of the Composer target set at two sites (also send_effects/mod.rs:410) and compared to the slot at scheduled.rs:367; a path that opens the picker without setting it sends nothing
fix: ScheduleTarget::ComposerThenSend { effect } so target and mode are one value
